text:
Ravi (People Ops): FYI: artist drop-off at 3pm — crate + toolbox marked fragile. Visitor will bring their partner who prefers a quiet seat. Kiosk flaky lately. Can someone stand by for manual badge flow and a soft-seat setup? :wave:

Sam (Front Desk): On it. Kiosk returning 504 for me. I can do manual. Where to keep the crate?

DeliveryBot: ETA 2:48pm. Items: 1 crate (fragile), 1 small toolbox. Leave at desk if recipient present.

Tess: I'll grab the courier at 2:45 and move crate to Storage C (back hall). I'll stick the fragile tag on top.

Ravi (People Ops): Perfect — please also reserve the east window bench, add a throw pillow and small side tray. Visitor badge should be photo+visitor. If kiosk down, use fallback below.

Sam (Front Desk): Manual badge fallback (kiosk down):
```
# manual badge quick script
/usr/bin/capture_photo --outfile /tmp/visitor.jpg
/usr/local/bin/mkbadge --name "Alex" --role Visitor --photo /tmp/visitor.jpg --ttl 8h > /tmp/alex_badge.pdf
lp -d Badge_Printer /tmp/alex_badge.pdf
```
I'll provision guest_wlan for 8 hours as well.

BadgePrinterBot: NOTICE - awaiting paper load at 2:50pm.

Sam (Front Desk): Paper loaded. Printing now.

Tess: Courier dropped at 2:53, signed (Tess). Crate in Storage C, labeled "Alex - fragile - do not stack". Left note: "extra bracket in lid".

Ravi (People Ops): Thanks. Seating poll for partner: East bench :couch: or small meeting nook :seat:? Reply with emoji.

Tess: :couch: bench is quieter. Moved an extra blanket over.

Sam (Front Desk): Checked in at 2:58, ID verified, badge printed. Partner seated at east bench with blanket + water. All set.

Ravi (People Ops): Awesome — added "extra bracket in lid" to install notes and pinged facilities. Closing thread, big thanks :raised_hands:
